versions.name: RXV2-0.9.336-phone-restore
versions.notes: The confused pilot's parachute: 'Restore settings from phone' on the Rotorflight page writes back EVERY recorded setting — PIDs, advanced PIDs, rates and governor, all four banks — from the app's session recording, even if no backup was ever made. Transmitter must be off; every item is verified by read-back.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.335-bank-assert
versions.notes: Every save now re-selects its own bank at the exact moment of writing — no possibility of values landing in a different bank, no matter what else is talking to the flight controller. Combined with read-back verification, saves are now bank-proof end to end.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.334-keyboard-buttons
versions.notes: The floating Save/Back bar now rides up above the on-screen keyboard while you edit a value, instead of sinking behind it.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.333-fast-lane-banner
versions.notes: The front-page update banner now takes the WiFi fast lane too — the earlier fix only covered the Check-for-Update page, so banner installs still streamed over Bluetooth even with the receiver on WiFi.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.332-switch-model
versions.notes: New front-screen button in the app: 'Load another model' — drops back to the receiver list to pick a different craft, no more force-quitting the app to change models.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.331-tuning-polish
versions.notes: Tuning pages polished: Save and Back now float at the bottom of the screen (no more scrolling); every save reads BACK from the flight controller and announces 'Written & verified!' right on the button; and the app's background recording now waits its turn so pages never show another bank's values. The update page also says up front whether an install will use WiFi (fast) or Bluetooth, and why.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.330-even-cells
versions.notes: Cell-count guessing got wiser: packs above 4S only come in even counts (6S, 8S, 12S — never 11S), so the voltage fallback now rounds odd guesses up. The flight controller's own answer still wins when available.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.329-fc-cell-count
versions.notes: Battery cell count now comes from the flight controller itself (MSP battery state) instead of being guessed from voltage — a 12S pack at 45 V no longer masquerades as an 11S. The guess remains only as a fallback for models without an FC answer.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.328-crsf-everywhere
versions.notes: CRSF is now the default in every corner: even a crash-recovery boot speaks CRSF (the fleet's language) instead of SBUS, so a rescued receiver still talks to its Rotorflight FC. Saved settings remain untouched by recovery.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.327-no-silent-sbus
versions.notes: Fixes the mystery CRSF-to-SBUS reverts: quick bench sessions ending with a battery pull (transmitter still on) were counted as crash reboots, and the third one silently reset the protocol. The healthy-boot counter now clears even with the transmitter on (never while armed, gap pardoned), and crash recovery no longer rewrites your saved protocol at all - it just uses SBUS for that one boot.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.326-fast-lane-update
versions.notes: Updates take the fastest road automatically: when the receiver's own WiFi is connected, installs download at WiFi speed even when you're using the app over Bluetooth (30-90 s instead of minutes). Bluetooth streaming remains the automatic fallback at the field.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.325-gear-field-fix
versions.notes: The gear-ratio box no longer fights your typing — the page's background refresh was rewriting it mid-keystroke. Type, save, done.
